Short Description About the Counselor:
I am Shaikh Mussadique Ahmed Mushtaque, currently pursuing a Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry. I specialize in chemistry practicals and advanced-level teaching. From 2017 to 2022, I taught postgraduate (M.Sc. Chemistry) students at Maulana Azad College, Aurangabad.
I am also the President of Mavin Star Education and Welfare Society, Aurangabad, an organization working in the education and healthcare sectors with 120 volunteers. I have published one patent and three research papers in reputed journals. My aim is to provide quality education and guide students toward academic excellence.
